Enquiries are not bookings

Browsing a sample itinerary or preparing an enquiry does not reserve accommodation, transport, tickets, or any other service. The website does not accept payment.

Confirm the proposal in writing

Before booking, obtain the legal business name, invoice details, exact dates, guest names, accommodation and room categories, transport arrangements, meal plan, itemised inclusions and exclusions, total price, applicable taxes, and service availability.

Payment terms still needed

Owner to supply: deposit amount, balance deadline, accepted payment methods, verified payee, receipt process, and the point at which a booking becomes confirmed. No payment timetable or guarantee is assumed here.

Travel responsibilities

Ask about identification, permits, insurance, accessibility needs, altitude suitability, and restrictions relevant to your chosen route. Service-specific conditions must be disclosed in your final proposal.

Changes and disputes

Owner to supply: procedures for itinerary changes, unavailable services, disruption, complaints, governing terms, and dispute resolution. Review the draft cancellation page and request final conditions before paying.
cancellation:
Draft policy — business approval required. This page is a transparent placeholder for the owner’s final policy. It must be reviewed and completed before accepting bookings or payments.

No invented refund promises

Cancellation charges, refund eligibility, and processing times have not been supplied by the business. This website does not advertise a refund percentage or a free-cancellation period.

Before any payment

  • Request date-based cancellation charges and the deadline for submitting a cancellation.
  • Ask which hotel, transport, ticket, or permit charges are non-refundable.
  • Confirm rules for amendments, no-shows, early departures, and unused services.
  • Ask how weather, road closures, government restrictions, and supplier cancellations are handled.
  • Get the refund method, processing timeline, deductions, and escalation contact in writing.

How to raise a request

Contact the business through your confirmed booking channel with your booking reference and requested change. Do not assume the request has been accepted until the business acknowledges it in writing.

Owner to complete: final cancellation schedule, refund process, supplier exceptions, and the complaints contact.
privacy:
Draft policy — business approval required. This page is a transparent placeholder for the owner’s final policy. It must be reviewed and completed before accepting bookings or payments.

What this website does

The enquiry form processes the details you enter in your browser to prepare an email draft or copyable text. It does not submit your information to a website database or use browser storage. Sending the email shares those details with your email provider and the receiving business.

Information you may choose to share

Name, email, optional phone number, travel dates, destination, group size, trip length, and your preferences. Please do not include passport scans, payment card details, medical records, or other sensitive information in this enquiry.

Hosting and external services

The website is designed for GitHub Pages hosting. Hosting providers may process connection information such as IP addresses. Google Fonts requests expose connection information to Google. Email and any future enabled WhatsApp links open third-party services under their own terms. No analytics, advertising scripts, or tracking cookies have been added by this redesign.

Business handling after you send

Owner details needed: legal data controller name, retention period, access controls, service providers, rights request procedure, and applicable contact address. These have not been supplied and are not represented as verified.

Questions

Use sales@theholidayhost.in to ask the business about its information handling before sharing additional personal details. This address was carried over from the existing site and awaits owner reconfirmation.
